posterAlt: Slow-motion side view of a lifter performing a controlled Barbell Squat inside a power rack.

script.speaker: Coach
script.text: Walk under the bar and rest it across the meaty part of your upper back. Place your hands just outside your shoulders.

script.speaker: Coach
script.text: Stand up tall to lift the bar off the hooks. Take two small steps back and set your feet shoulder-width apart.

script.speaker: Coach
script.text: Take a big breath into your belly and tighten your stomach. Push your hips back and bend your knees at the same time.

script.speaker: Coach
script.text: Lower down slowly until your hips are level with your knees. Keep your heels flat on the floor the whole time.

script.speaker: Coach
script.text: Push the floor away through your whole foot to stand back up straight. Breathe out near the top.

literalSteps.title: Set the Bar on Your Upper Back
literalSteps.instruction: Step under the bar. Place it on the flat muscle across your upper back, below your neck. Hold the bar tightly just outside your shoulders.
literalSteps.safetyCue: Do not rest the bar on the bony part of your neck.

literalSteps.title: Stand Up and Step Back
literalSteps.instruction: Stand straight up to lift the bar off the rack. Take two calm steps back. Set your feet about shoulder-width apart with toes turned out slightly.
literalSteps.safetyCue: Stop moving your feet before you start bending.

literalSteps.title: Breathe In and Brace Your Belly
literalSteps.instruction: Take one deep breath into your belly. Make your stomach firm like you are about to cough. Bend your hips and knees together.
literalSteps.safetyCue: Keep your chest facing forward, not down at your shoes.

literalSteps.title: Lower Down Under Control
literalSteps.instruction: Sit down slowly between your heels until your thighs are flat like a chair seat. Keep your knees pointing the same way as your toes.
literalSteps.safetyCue: Keep your heels glued flat on the floor.

literalSteps.title: Push the Floor Away to Stand
literalSteps.instruction: Press hard through the middle of both feet to stand all the way back up. Let your breath out as you reach the top.
literalSteps.safetyCue: Pause for 1 second before starting your next rep.
